notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five enchantments.
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If you control six or more enchantments and/or control another creature that can tap to produce mana, this combo nets infinite mana.
